inicio.titulo: Freshly made churros in the heart of Seville

hero.lede: Thin and thick churros, golden outside and soft inside. With thick hot chocolate or with coffee, the way Seville has always had them.

productos.titulo: Two churros, two ways to enjoy them

finos.texto: Thin, crisp and deeply ridged. The classic Spanish churro.

largos.texto: Thick and fluffy inside, also known as porras.

acompanar.texto: For slow dipping: thick hot chocolate or a good milky coffee.

latas.texto: Layered desserts served in a can: cream, biscuit and chocolate right to the rim. Chocolate, or pistachio with cream.

nosotros.titulo: Churros, straight out of the oil
nosotros.texto: A churro is at its best in the first few minutes. That's why at El Don del Churro we make them to order, right in the centre of Seville, and serve them hot.
